Co-founder · Product & engineering

Trus

Software shaped around the person using it.

A generative workspace platform that turns plain-English descriptions into working tools. I helped build the first version and now focus on product direction and go-to-market.

Inside the work +

A deliberate constraint

In the first version, the model produced a structured configuration. A trusted component library turned that configuration into a working interface. This kept generation inside a defined set of capabilities.

My contribution

Hands-on development of the original workspace, followed by product and go-to-market work on the next version. My co-founder, Diego Sanchez, leads the current engineering build.
